description: Lab tests dated on 1985-04-22 or on 1994-03-14 are included in the range, along with every test between them.

c.request: For laboratory tests between 1985-04-22 and 1994-03-14 (comparing the `Date` text as stored), what is the average hemoglobin (`HGB`) and the average total bilirubin-to-creatinine ratio (`T-BIL` ÷ `CRE`, per test) for each anti-centromere status (`CENTROMEA`, with a missing status as its own group)? Also give each status's average ratio divided by the plain mean of all the statuses' average ratios. Ignore missing values in the averages, return nothing if that overall mean is missing, and don't round. Lab tests dated on 1985-04-22 or on 1994-03-14 are included in the range, along with every test between them.
c.sql:
WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT
    CENTROMEA,
    AVG(HGB) AS average_hemoglobin,
    AVG(`T-BIL` / CRE) AS average_ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14'
  GROUP BY CENTROMEA
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS overall_mean_ratio
  FROM status_averages
)
SELECT
  status_averages.CENTROMEA,
  status_averages.average_hemoglobin,
  status_averages.average_ratio,
  status_averages.average_ratio / overall.overall_mean_ratio AS ratio_relative_to_overall_mean
FROM status_averages
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE overall.overall_mean_ratio IS NOT NULL;

d.request: Group laboratory tests by CENTROMEA, treating missing status as its own group, and include tests whose stored Date text is between 1985-04-22 and 1994-03-14, inclusive. For each group, return the average HGB and the average per-test T-BIL / CRE ratio, ignoring missing values in each average; also return that group’s average ratio divided by the unweighted mean of all groups’ average ratios. Return no rows if that overall mean is missing, and do not round.
d.sql:
WITH grouped AS (
    SELECT
        CENTROMEA,
        AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb,
        AVG(CAST(`T-BIL` AS REAL) / NULLIF(CRE, 0)) AS avg_tbil_cre_ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST(Date AS TEXT) BETWEEN '1985-04-22' AND '1994-03-14'
    GROUP BY CENTROMEA
), with_overall AS (
    SELECT
        CENTROMEA,
        avg_hgb,
        avg_tbil_cre_ratio,
        AVG(avg_tbil_cre_ratio) OVER () AS overall_mean_ratio
    FROM grouped
)
SELECT
    CENTROMEA,
    avg_hgb,
    avg_tbil_cre_ratio,
    avg_tbil_cre_ratio / NULLIF(overall_mean_ratio, 0) AS ratio_to_overall_mean
FROM with_overall
WHERE overall_mean_ratio IS NOT NULL

a.request: Using laboratory tests dated from 1985-04-22 through 1994-03-14 inclusive (comparing the `Date` text as stored), for each anti-centromere status (`CENTROMEA`, with a missing status as its own group), give the status, the average hemoglobin (`HGB`), the average of each test's total bilirubin-to-creatinine ratio (`T-BIL` ÷ `CRE`), and that average ratio divided by the plain mean of all the statuses' average ratios. Ignore missing values in every average, return nothing if that overall mean is missing, and don't round.
a.sql:
WITH per_status AS (
  SELECT
    CENTROMEA AS status,
    AVG(HGB) AS average_hemoglobin,
    AVG(`T-BIL` / CRE) AS average_ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14'
  GROUP BY CENTROMEA
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS overall_mean_ratio
  FROM per_status
)
SELECT
  p.status,
  p.average_hemoglobin,
  p.average_ratio,
  p.average_ratio / o.overall_mean_ratio AS ratio_divided_by_overall_mean
FROM per_status AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.overall_mean_ratio IS NOT NULL;

b.request: Include laboratory tests whose stored `Date` text is between `1985-04-22` and `1994-03-14`, inclusive; for each `CENTROMEA` status, grouping missing status separately, return the mean `HGB` and the mean per-test `T-BIL / CRE` ratio, ignoring missing values in each mean, plus that status’s mean ratio divided by the unweighted mean of all statuses’ mean ratios; return no rows if that overall mean is missing and do not round.
b.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT CENTROMEA, HGB, `T-BIL` / NULLIF(CRE, 0) AS test_ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14'
), status_means AS (
  SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(HGB) AS mean_hgb, AVG(test_ratio) AS mean_ratio
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY CENTROMEA
), with_overall AS (
  SELECT CENTROMEA, mean_hgb, mean_ratio,
         AVG(mean_ratio) OVER () AS overall_mean_ratio
  FROM status_means
)
SELECT CENTROMEA, mean_hgb, mean_ratio,
       mean_ratio / NULLIF(overall_mean_ratio, 0) AS ratio_to_overall_mean
FROM with_overall
WHERE overall_mean_ratio IS NOT NULL
